items.title: Shewanella atlantica-derived protein-expressing microorganism and L-amino acid production method using same
items.abstract: Provided are a foreign protein-expressing microorganism and an L-amino acid production method using same. The foreign protein-expressing microorganism may have improved L-amino acid excretion and/or production capacity, compared to a wild type.
